query: SELECT m.name, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(u.prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(u.completion_tokens, 0)), 0)::bigint AS "tokens!" FROM agent_team_members m JOIN agent_teams t ON t.id = m.team_id LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND u.created_at >= COALESCE((SELECT r.started_at FROM agent_team_rounds r WHERE r.team_id = t.id AND r.round = t.round), t.created_at) WHERE m.team_id = $1 AND m.round = t.round GROUP BY m.name, m.created_at ORDER BY m.created_at
